repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · L1 · head `c2c6bbd122372bc624aa1ad9a4aa59e8a7b527a1` · 2026-11-24T15:58Z

- **Shape.** Draft PR to `main`, first line `Fixes #36967`; one test file, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/useDeferredFirstSend.test.tsx` (+40/−36), inside the claim's surface. Test-only: `skip-changeset` is right (nothing published changes). `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- **Premise and fix.** The fixed `setTimeout(0)` wait (`flushReplay`, 14 sites) raced the effect that arms the replay timer when React flushes it outside `act` (the pane remount after the async create). The 12 sites that should replay now `waitFor` the observable their next assertion reads (`doSend` count or arguments). The 2 sites that must NOT replay cannot use `waitFor` (it passes on a negative at once); they go through `actThenRunPendingTimers` (fake `setTimeout`/`clearTimeout` only, `act(step)`, then `act(runOnlyPendingTimers)`, real timers restored in `finally`), so every timer the step armed has fired before the negative is read. No assertion weakened, no retry, no skip.
- **Evidence.** 30/30 green in a row; 10/10 green under CPU load (six busy loops on 4 cores, one fork worker). Leg A (replay timer delayed to 50 ms in `AiChatPage.tsx`, not committed): the new file stays green, the main copy fails 12 of 15 — the new waits are robust to the race the old ones lost. Leg B (targeted-stash guard deleted): exactly the negative case fails — the drain still catches a leaked replay. Restores blob-equal. app-shell type-check (source and test program) exit 0; 27 derived gate families exit 0.
- **Accepted deviation.** The dispatch asked for condition waits everywhere; the 2 negative sites use the deterministic timer drain instead, for the reason above. The three `await act(async () => {})` mount settles are microtask flushes, not timer waits, and stay.
- **Gates.** Check-runs at this head: all green when this record was posted (`pr-state.mjs --pr 37014`).
- **Landing K.** `landing-k.mjs` could not answer (no Test Core shard ran on this UI-only head); counted by hand: 8 first-parent commits on main since the merge base, K = 8 < 15.
- No must-fix, no should-fix. After this merges, PR #36869 (#35399) re-queues.
